Aero 1.2.70: long chats stay fast, even after a restart.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere; `--lean` skips setting up the integrations now (Aero finishes them in the background). |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.2.70_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.2.70_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.2.70-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.2.70-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, skills and mods carry over.

## What's new

- **Your chat keeps its own slot.** Memory, reflection, journal and title jobs run in a second slot, so they no longer push your conversation out of the cache. Both slots share one memory pool, so this costs no extra VRAM.
- **Chats pick up where they left off.** A long chat's prompt cache is saved to disk and restored after a restart. In testing, 8,709 of 9,594 tokens were reused instead of read again.
- **Cache reuse and a RAM prompt cache.** Unchanged parts are reused after an edit, and recent prompts stay in RAM.
- **Settings.** Model & tuning has parallel slots, cache reuse, RAM cache size and saved-cache size (at most 4 GB by default, oldest first). Deleting a chat deletes its cache.

Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md).
